hypotheses.Q1_family_forms_are_exact: The complete family-conditioned eigensystems reconstruct the exact family-output projection within 1e-4 relative error.
hypotheses.Q2_family_output4_is_causally_substantia: The leave-one-pair-out family output rank-4 projection reaches at least 0.20 median downstream fidelity to the full MLP3 patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q3_rank64_interactions_recover_family_pa: Sixty-four interaction modes per family output axis reach at least 0.70 median downstream fidelity to the exact family-output patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q4_rank256_interactions_nearly_recover_f: Two hundred fifty-six modes per axis reach at least 0.90 median fidelity to the exact family-output patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q5_spectral256_beats_native_family_addre: The family spectral rank-256 patch has at least 0.05 more fidelity to the full MLP3 patch than native leave-one-pair-out family channels on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q6_family_output_basis_beats_global_basi: The family output projection exceeds a leave-one-pair-out global output projection by at least 0.03 full-MLP fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.Q7_family_output_basis_is_semantically_s: The correct family output projection exceeds the best wrong-family output projection in median on both corpora.
